Muslim (official; citizens are 85-90% Sunni and 10-12% Shia), other (includes Eastern Orthodox, Protestant, Roman Catholic, Jewish, Hindu, Buddhist, and Sikh) (2020 est.)

note: despite having a large expatriate community of various faiths (more than 30% of the population), most forms of public religious expression inconsistent with the government-sanctioned interpretation of Sunni Islam are restricted; non-Muslims are not allowed to have Saudi citizenship and non-Muslim places of worship are not permitted (2013)

Senegal.region: Western Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between Guinea-Bissau and Mauritania
Senegal.religion: Muslim 97.2% (most adhere to one of the four main Sufi brotherhoods), Christian 2.7% (mostly Roman Catholic) (2019 est.)

Serbia (Yugoslavia).region: Southeastern Europe, between Macedonia and Hungary
Serbia (Yugoslavia).religion:
Orthodox 84.6%, Catholic 5%, Muslim 3.1%, Protestant 1%, atheist 1.1%, other 0.8% (includes agnostics, other Christians, Eastern, Jewish), undeclared or unknown 4.5% (2011 est.)

note: most ethnic Albanians boycotted the 2011 census

Sierra Leone.region: Western Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between Guinea and Liberia

Solomon Islands.region: Oceania, group of islands in the South Pacific Ocean, east of Papua New Guinea
Solomon Islands.religion: Protestant 73.4% (Church of Melanesia 31.9%, South Sea Evangelical 17.1%, Seventh Day Adventist 11.7%, United Church 10.1%, Christian Fellowship Church 2.5%), Roman Catholic 19.6%, other Christian 2.9%, other 4%, unspecified 0.1% (2009 est.)

Somalia.region: Eastern Africa, bordering the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean, east of Ethiopia
Somalia.religion: Muslim 99.9% (Sunni Muslim 98.1%, Shia Muslim 1.2%, Islamic schismatic 0.6%), ethnic religionist 0.1% (2020 est.)

South Africa.region: Southern Africa, at the southern tip of the continent of Africa
South Africa.religion: Christian 86%, ancestral, tribal, animist, or other traditional African religions 5.4%, Muslim 1.9%, other 1.5%, nothing in particular 5.2% (2015 est.)

South Sudan.region: East-Central Africa; south of Sudan, north of Uganda and Kenya, west of Ethiopia
South Sudan.religion: Christian 60.5%, folk religion 32.9%, Muslim 6.2%, other <1%, unaffiliated <1% (2020 est.)

Spain.region: Southwestern Europe, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, North Atlantic Ocean, Bay of Biscay, and Pyrenees Mountains; southwest of France
Spain.religion: Roman Catholic 58.2%, atheist 16.2%, agnostic 10.8%, other 2.7%, non-believer 10.5%, unspecified 1.7% (2021 est.)

Sri Lanka.region: Southern Asia, island in the Indian Ocean, south of India
Sri Lanka.religion: Buddhist (official) 70.2%, Hindu 12.6%, Muslim 9.7%, Roman Catholic 6.1%, other Christian 1.3%, other 0.05% (2012 est.)

Sudan.region: north-eastern Africa, bordering the Red Sea, between Egypt and Eritrea

Sweden.region: Northern Europe, bordering the Baltic Sea, Gulf of Bothnia, Kattegat, and Skagerrak, between Finland and Norway
Sweden.religion:
Church of Sweden (Lutheran) 53.9%, other (includes Roman Catholic, Orthodox, Baptist, Muslim, Jewish, and Buddhist) 8.9%, none or unspecified 37.2% (2021 est.)

note: estimates reflect registered members of faith communities eligible for state funding (not all religions are state-funded and not all people who identify with a particular religion are registered members) and the Church of Sweden

Syria.region: Middle East, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Lebanon and Turkey
Syria.religion:
Muslim 87% (official; includes Sunni 74% and Alawi, Ismaili, and Shia 13%), Christian 10% (includes Orthodox, Uniate, and Nestorian), Druze 3%

note:  the Christian population may be considerably smaller as a result of Christians fleeing the country during the ongoing civil war

Tajikistan.region: Central Asia, west of China, south of Kyrgyzstan

Tanzania.region: Eastern Africa, bordering the Indian Ocean, between Kenya and Mozambique
Tanzania.religion:
Christian 63.1%, Muslim 34.1%, folk religion 1.1%, Buddhist <1%, Hindu <1%, Jewish <1%, other <1%, unspecified 1.6% (2020 est.)

note: Zanzibar is almost entirely Muslim

Thailand.region: Southeastern Asia, bordering the Andaman Sea and the Gulf of Thailand, southeast of Burma
Thailand.religion: Buddhist 92.5%, Muslim 5.4%, Christian 1.2%, other 0.9% (includes animist, Confucian, Hindu, Jewish, Sikh, and Taoist) (2021 est.)

Togo.region: Western Africa, bordering the Bight of Benin, between Benin and Ghana
Togo.religion: Christian 42.3%, folk religion 36.9%, Muslim 14%, Hindu <1%, Buddhist <1%, Jewish <1%, other <1%, none 6.2% (2020 est.)

Trinidad and Tobago.region: Caribbean, islands between the Caribbean Sea and the North Atlantic Ocean, northeast of Venezuela
Trinidad and Tobago.religion: Protestant 32.1% (Pentecostal/Evangelical/Full Gospel 12%, Baptist 6.9%, Anglican 5.7%, Seventh Day Adventist 4.1%, Presbyterian/Congregational 2.5%, other Protestant 0.9%), Roman Catholic 21.6%, Hindu 18.2%, Muslim 5%, Jehovah's Witness 1.5%, other 8.4%, none 2.2%, unspecified 11.1% (2011 est.)

Tunisia.region: Northern Africa, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Algeria and Libya
Tunisia.religion: Muslim (official; Sunni) 99%, other (includes Christian, Jewish, Shia Muslim, and Baha'i) <1%

Turkey.region: Southeastern Europe and Southwestern Asia (that portion of Turkey west of the Bosporus is geographically part of Europe), bordering the Black Sea, between Bulgaria and Georgia, and bordering the Aegean Sea and the Mediterranean Sea, between Greece and Syria
Turkey.religion: Muslim 99.8% (mostly Sunni), other 0.2% (mostly Christians and Jews)

Uganda.region: East-Central Africa, west of Kenya, east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Uganda.religion: Protestant 45.1% (Anglican 32.0%, Pentecostal/Born Again/Evangelical 11.1%, Seventh Day Adventist 1.7%, Baptist .3%), Roman Catholic 39.3%, Muslim 13.7%, other 1.6%, none 0.2% (2014 est.)

Ukraine.region: Eastern Europe, bordering the Black Sea, between Poland, Belarus, Romania, and Moldova in the west and Russia in the east
Ukraine.religion:
Orthodox (includes the Orthodox Church of Ukraine (OCU), Ukrainian Autocephalous Orthodox Church (UAOC), and the Ukrainian Orthodox - Moscow Patriarchate (UOC-MP)), Ukrainian Greek Catholic, Roman Catholic, Protestant, Muslim, Jewish (2013 est.)

note: Ukraine's population is overwhelmingly Christian; the vast majority - up to two thirds - identify themselves as Orthodox, but many do not specify a particular branch; the OCU and the UOC-MP each represent less than a quarter of the country's population, the Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church accounts for 8-10%, and the UAOC accounts for 1-2%; Muslim and Jewish adherents each compose less than 1% of the total population

United Arab Emirates.region: Middle East, bordering the Gulf of Oman and the Persian Gulf, between Oman and Saudi Arabia
United Arab Emirates.religion:
Muslim 74.5% (official) (Sunni 63.3%, Shia 6.7%, other 4.4%), Christian 12.9%, Hindu 6.2%, Buddhist 3.2%, agnostic 1.3%, other 1.9% (2020 est.)

note: data represent the total population; as of 2020, immigrants make up about 88.1% of the total population, according to UN data

United States of America.region: North America, bordering both the North Atlantic Ocean and the North Pacific Ocean, between Canada and Mexico

Uzbekistan.region: Central Asia, north of Turkmenistan, south of Kazakhstan

Venezuela.region: Northern South America, bordering the Caribbean Sea and the North Atlantic Ocean, between Colombia and Guyana
Venezuela.religion: Roman Catholic 48.1%, Protestant 31.6% (Evangelical 31.4%, Adventist 0.2%), Jehovah's Witness 1.4%, African American/umbanda 0.7%, other 0.1%, believer 3.5%, agnostic 0.1%, atheist, 0.4%, none 13.6%, unspecified 0.6% (2023 est.)

Yemen (North Yemen).region: Middle East, bordering the Arabian Sea, Gulf of Aden, and Red Sea, between Oman and Saudi Arabia
